deployment_bootstraps_terminal_check.name: deployment_bootstraps_terminal_check
deployment_bootstraps_terminal_check.value:
(
        "emdo"."deployment_bootstraps"."state" = 'in_progress'
        and "emdo"."deployment_bootstraps"."completed_at" is null
        and "emdo"."deployment_bootstraps"."user_id" is null
        and "emdo"."deployment_bootstraps"."household_id" is null
        and "emdo"."deployment_bootstraps"."membership_id" is null
        and "emdo"."deployment_bootstraps"."private_space_id" is null
      ) or (
        "emdo"."deployment_bootstraps"."state" = 'complete'
        and "emdo"."deployment_bootstraps"."completed_at" is not null
        and "emdo"."deployment_bootstraps"."completed_at" >= "emdo"."deployment_bootstraps"."started_at"
        and "emdo"."deployment_bootstraps"."user_id" is not null
        and "emdo"."deployment_bootstraps"."household_id" is not null
        and "emdo"."deployment_bootstraps"."membership_id" is not null
        and "emdo"."deployment_bootstraps"."private_space_id" is not null
      )

disclosure_grants_terminal_check.name: disclosure_grants_terminal_check
disclosure_grants_terminal_check.value: not ("emdo"."disclosure_grants"."consumed_at" is not null and "emdo"."disclosure_grants"."revoked_at" is not null)

household_memberships_ended_status_check.name: household_memberships_ended_status_check
household_memberships_ended_status_check.value: ("emdo"."household_memberships"."status" = 'active' and "emdo"."household_memberships"."ended_at" is null) or ("emdo"."household_memberships"."status" = 'inactive' and "emdo"."household_memberships"."ended_at" is not null)

invitations_terminal_check.name: invitations_terminal_check
invitations_terminal_check.value: not ("emdo"."invitations"."consumed_at" is not null and "emdo"."invitations"."revoked_at" is not null)

provider_attempts_dispatch_time_check.name: provider_attempts_dispatch_time_check
provider_attempts_dispatch_time_check.value: ("emdo"."provider_attempts"."attempt_state" = 'prepared' and "emdo"."provider_attempts"."dispatched_at" is null) or ("emdo"."provider_attempts"."attempt_state" <> 'prepared' and "emdo"."provider_attempts"."dispatched_at" is not null)

emdo.active_household_memberships.definition:
select id, household_id as organization_id, user_id, role,
                 joined_at as created_at
            from emdo.household_memberships
           where status = 'active'
emdo.active_household_memberships.name: active_household_memberships

emdo.better_auth_invitations.definition:
select id, household_id as organization_id, email, role,
                 'pending'::text as status,
                 expires_at, created_at, invited_by_user_id as inviter_id
            from emdo.invitations
           where consumed_at is null
             and revoked_at is null
             and expires_at > clock_timestamp()
emdo.better_auth_invitations.name: better_auth_invitations

emdo.better_auth_organizations.definition:
select id, name, slug, logo, metadata, created_at
            from emdo.households
emdo.better_auth_organizations.name: better_auth_organizations
